title: UFO claims raised on the floor of Congress

tellings.quote: I I mean I it's been on the floor of the Congress and things like that that it has to that's got to pump the probability up a little bit, right?

plain: UFO claims have been raised on the floor of the US Congress, and the philosopher James Madden says on Michels' show that this has to raise the odds that something is there. He mentions it in passing, without saying which claims or when.
